title: CH Generators
description: CH-Generators adds three tiers of configurable item generators (Mk I, II, III) that automatically generate items based on your TOML configuration. Perfect for automated setups with Create mod and Compressed Blocks support.
body:
Upgradeable generators compatible with Create & Compressed Blocks

CH-Generators adds three tiers of configurable item generators (Mk I, II, III) that automatically generate items based on your JSON configuration. Perfect for automated setups with Create mod and Compressed Blocks support.

Key Features
🔧 Three Upgradeable Tiers - Progress from Mk I to Mk III with increasing speed and output multipliers (1x, 1.2x, 1.4x, configurables)

⚙️ Fully Configurable - Whitelist items per tier, set custom output rates, adjust generation intervals, and configure stack limits via JSON config

🔌 Create Integration - Works seamlessly with Create's funnels and mechanical systems

📦 Compressed Blocks Support - Generate compressed blocks directly with configured output rates

🎯 Smart Inventory - Internal inventory system compatible with hoppers and funnels for easy automation
